constitution_rules.rule_7_hard_cap: ABS(actual_return) <= 50 — every KPI must cap before averaging.
constitution_rules.rule_8_no_channel_mixing: balanced != morning_bell — never combine the two into a single number without an explicit by_channel breakdown.
constitution_rules.rule_9_avg_loss_sign: avg_loss MUST be reported as a negative number (sign convention).
constitution_rules.rule_10_no_kpi_without_provenance: every KPI published to the UI MUST cite its source table, query, filters, sample size, exclusions, and capped_rows.

kpis.kpi_name: Total Return + Win Rate + Trades (kimi/backtest/run — Python proxy with stub fallback)
kpis.source_table: price_history.db.price_history (simulated backtest trades, NOT predictions.predictions) | STUB when Python unavailable (zeros)
kpis.query_summary: Python side: simulates BUY/SELL trades per ticker per week from price_history, computes pnl_pct = (entry-exit)/entry*100, then: wins = [t for t in all_trades if pnl_pct > 0]; losses = [t for t in all_trades if pnl_pct <= 0]; win_rate = win_count/total_trades*100; profit_factor = total_profit / abs(total_loss); avg_win = total_profit / win_count; avg_loss = total_loss / loss_count  (where total_loss = abs(sum(losses)) — POSITIVE magnitude). TS side: returns Python results if 200 OK, otherwise stub with win_rate=0, total_return=0, trades_count=0.

sample.n_raw: simulated trades (one per ticker per week in window)

kpis.avg_loss_sign: POSITIVE (magnitude) — violates rule_9 sign convention. avg_loss = total_loss / loss_count where total_loss = abs(sum(losses)). If displayed verbatim to the user as 'avg_loss', it is misleading because every other KPI in the system uses negative sign.
failure_reasons: avg_loss is reported as a POSITIVE magnitude (sum(abs(loss))/n_losses) — violates rule_9 sign convention. Other KPIs in the system report avg_loss as negative.
No HARD cap on pnl_pct — outlier simulated trades bias the average.
No dedup (trades are simulated per (ticker, week), so duplicates are unlikely but not enforced).
No channel separation.
No exclusion_breakdown.
Stub fallback returns zeros without provenance marker other than source='stub' (acceptable, but the stub path does NOT publish provenance fields either).
